DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日のご説明について、ほかにご質問はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any other questions about today's explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日の入金の話は分かりました。別に住宅の資金相談もしたいですが、今の窓口で長く続けるのではなく予約の方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金相談終了後に住宅資金の別予約方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I understand today's discussion about the deposit. I would also like a separate consultation about financing a home, but instead of continuing at this counter for a long time, please tell me how to make an appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After finishing the deposit consultation, ask how to make a separate appointment about home financing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 資金のご相談は、担当窓口へ予約の方法を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can check how to book a financial consultation with the counter in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 次回の希望を申し出ます。家の購入時期はまだ未定で、今日ここで金額や契約を決めたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入未定で当日金額契約決定不要を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will state my preferences for the next visit. I have not decided when to buy a home yet, and I do not intend to decide on an amount or a contract here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that the purchase timing is undecided and that you do not need to decide on an amount or contract today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談時に伺う情報と、準備する資料の案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will give you a guide to the information we will ask for during the consultation and the documents to prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内を読みます。今の収入が分かる物と、検討している費用のメモを、次の相談のために用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 次相談の収入資料と費用メモ準備を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will read the guide. I will prepare something showing my current income and notes on the costs I am considering for the next consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to prepare income documents and cost notes for the next consultation. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は予約方法の案内で、審査や融資の受付を終えたものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: For now, this is guidance on making an appointment; it does not mean that screening or a loan application has been received and processed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その点も分かりました。入金の控えとは別に保管し、住宅の相談は準備してから日時を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約案内を融資受付とせず入金控えと分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand that as well. I will keep it separately from the deposit receipt and decide on a date and time for the home consultation after I have prepared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not treat the appointment guide as acceptance of a loan application, and keep it separate from the deposit receipt. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の曜日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there a day of the week you would prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 仕事が休みの水曜を希望します。空き状況を聞いて予約できる日を選びます。今日は入金の手続きだけが済んだと記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水曜希望空き確認と今日入金のみ完了を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would prefer Wednesday, when I am off work. I will ask about availability and choose a day I can book. I will record that only the deposit procedure was completed today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your Wednesday preference, that you will check availability, and that only the deposit was completed today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、予約の担当へおつなぎします。ご利用ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you to the person in charge of appointments. Thank you for using our services. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱単位の飲み物のご注文ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to order drinks by the box, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の朝九時から地域行事があります。二十四人へ水を一本ずつ用意したいです。明日ここで受け取るなら、何時になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 九時行事二十四人の水注文の受取時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a community event starting at nine tomorrow morning. I would like one bottle of water for each of twenty-four people. What time would they be available if I pick them up here tomorrow?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the pickup time for an order of water for twenty-four people at an event starting at nine. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご注文分の到着予定は午前十時です。九時開始には間に合いません。今ある在庫でよろしいかも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your order is scheduled to arrive at ten in the morning. It will not be in time for the nine o'clock start. We can also check whether the stock we have now would work for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では明日の朝の受取りはやめ、今日用意できる分を持ち帰りたいです。一本ずつ二十四本が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十時到着を避け今日在庫二十四本を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will cancel the idea of picking them up tomorrow morning and take home what you can provide today. I need twenty-four individual bottles.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid the ten o'clock arrival and ask for twenty-four bottles from today's stock. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この六本入りの箱は、四箱ご用意できます。同じ容量と商品の物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can provide four of these boxes containing six bottles each. They are all the same product and size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四箱なら二十四本ですね。箱に入ったまま持ち帰れますか。会場で一本ずつ配るので、今日は店で全部出さなくて構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 六本四箱の総数と箱のまま受領を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Four boxes makes twenty-four bottles, right? Can I take them home still in the boxes? We will hand out individual bottles at the venue, so you do not need to take them all out here at the shop today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the total in four boxes of six and that you can receive them in their boxes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱のままお渡しできます。持ち帰る車は、お近くですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can hand them over in the boxes. Is the car you will take them home in nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駐車場にあります。同行の担当者と二箱ずつ車へ運び、家で保管してから明日持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車へ二人二箱ずつ運び家庭保管を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is in the parking lot. The colleague responsible who is with me and I will carry two boxes each to the car, store them at home, and take them tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that two people will carry two boxes each to the car and store them at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに四箱そろいました。ラベルの保存の案内もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: All four boxes are here. Please also read the storage instructions on the labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四箱を確認しました。保存の表示を読み、担当者へ今日受領したと連絡します。明日の十時到着の注文はせず、こちらを会計してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四箱表示確認で翌日注文せず現購入会計を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the four boxes. I will read the storage information and tell the person in charge that I received them today. I will not place the order arriving at ten tomorrow; please charge me for these.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the four boxes and labels, decline tomorrow's order, and request checkout for today's purchase. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、四箱のお会計をします。お持ち帰りにお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will ring up the four boxes. Please take care taking them home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人とも、同じ活動の班でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like both children in the same activity group?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 兄は絵を描く班、弟は虫を見る班を希望しています。同じ班へまとめる前に、別々に参加できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 兄弟別の絵と虫班希望と別参加可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The older brother wants the drawing group, and the younger brother wants the insect observation group. Before putting them together in one group, I would like to ask whether they can participate separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the brothers' different preferences for drawing and insect groups and ask whether they can join separately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの班の対象年齢と定員を確認します。お兄さんと弟さんのお歳は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check each group's age range and capacity. Could you tell me the older and younger brothers' ages?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十歳と八歳です。二人が別々の班へ行くなら、受付の時にそれぞれの名前を出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄弟年齢と各班別の本人氏名受付を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are ten and eight. If they go to separate groups, I would like to give each child's own name at registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the brothers' ages and request registration under each child's name in his own group. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どちらも対象で、空きがあります。終了後は中央の集合場所へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: They are both eligible, and there are places available. After the activities, they will return to the central meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人とも参加します。私は中央で待ちますが、班の活動場所と担当の方を先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両班参加を決め親待機と担当活動場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: They will both participate. I will wait in the center, but first I would like to check where the groups will do their activities and who is in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide that both will join, state that the parent will wait, and check the activity locations and leaders. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 絵の班は受付前、虫の班は園路側です。それぞれの担当者を紹介します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The drawing group is in front of reception, and the insect group is by the park path. I will introduce each group's leader.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当の方へ二人の名前を伝えました。弟が戻ってきても、兄の終了前に家へ帰ってしまわず中央で合流を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当へ氏名伝達し片子だけ先帰宅しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have told the leaders both children's names. Even if the younger brother returns, I will not go home before the older brother finishes; I will wait for everyone to meet in the center.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the leaders the children's names and do not go home early with just one child. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終了時刻はどちらも十一時です。変更があれば受付からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both groups finish at eleven. Reception will let you know if there are any changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十一時に中央で二人そろうと伝えました。それぞれが選んだ活動を楽しみ、最後に三人で帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 十一時中央全員合流と三人帰宅を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have told them that both children will meet in the center at eleven. They will enjoy their chosen activities, and the three of us will go home together at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Arrange for everyone to meet in the center at eleven and for all three to go home together. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、各班の担当へどうぞ。ご家族でお楽しみください。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the respective group leaders. Enjoy yourselves as a family. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お忘れ物の受け取りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect a lost item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日問い合わせた青い傘です。こちらの受付番号を見せればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付番号で問い合わせ済み傘の受取を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is the blue umbrella I asked about yesterday. Should I show you this reference number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to collect the umbrella you already inquired about using the reference number. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番号を確認します。傘の特徴もお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the number. Please also describe the umbrella's features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち手に白いテープを巻いています。先が少し曲がっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: テープと先端の特徴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is white tape wrapped around the handle. The tip is slightly bent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the tape and the tip's features. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 該当する傘をお持ちします。こちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will bring the umbrella that matches. Is this it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、私の傘です。テープの内側に名前もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現物と内側の名前を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it is my umbrella. My name is also on the inside of the tape.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the actual item and the name inside the tape. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前も確認できました。受け取りの記入をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have confirmed your name as well. Please fill in the collection record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここに日付と名前を書きます。傘袋も一緒に届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取欄を記入し傘袋の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write the date and my name here. Was the umbrella sleeve also turned in with it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Fill in the collection section and ask whether the umbrella sleeve is there. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋は届いていません。傘だけのお返しになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: No sleeve has been turned in. We can return only the umbrella.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。傘だけ受け取り、鞄の横に固定して持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 傘だけを固定して持ち帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I will collect just the umbrella, secure it to the side of my bag, and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will secure and take home only the umbrella. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お返しできてよかったです。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad we could return it to you. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの資料をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which information are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ごみの分け方の冊子です。この文字が小さいので、大きな文字の版はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 分別冊子の大文字版を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The booklet on sorting rubbish. This print is small, so is there a version in larger print?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a large-print version of the rubbish-sorting booklet. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 大きな文字の資料をご案内できます。特に知りたい品物はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can show you information in large print. Is there a particular item you want to know about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古いフライパンです。分別の項目を探していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 知りたい品目が古いフライパンと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: An old frying pan. I was looking for the sorting category.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that the item you want to know about is an old frying pan. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 品物ごとの一覧にも載っています。こちらの大きな文字のページをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is also listed in the item-by-item index. Please look at this large-print page.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 読めました。家で見るために、このページをもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大文字ページの持帰りを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can read it now. Could I have this page to look at at home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to take the large-print page home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しできます。収集日の表も同じ大きさでご用意しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may have it. Shall I also prepare a collection-day schedule in the same print size?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。住んでいる地区は、この地図の西側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地区を示して大文字収集表を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. The district where I live is on the west side of this map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate your district and request a large-print collection schedule. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 地区の表を添えました。品物の条件が分からない時は担当窓口へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have included your district's schedule. If you are unsure about the conditions for an item, please consult the counter in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一覧と日付表を家の壁へ貼ります。今日は必要な所を大きい文字で読めて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一覧と表を壁に貼って使うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the index and date schedule on a wall at home. Being able to read the parts I needed in large print today was helpful.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the index and schedule on the wall and use them. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お役に立ててよかったです。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad we could help. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 採血のご案内です。こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are ready for your blood draw. Please come this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 以前、採血の時に気分が悪くなりました。始める前にお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 採血時の気分不良歴を事前に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I felt unwell during a blood draw before. I would like to tell you before we start.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell them in advance that you have previously felt unwell during a blood draw. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 教えてくださってありがとうございます。その時は、どんな様子でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling us. What happened that time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 終わった直後に目の前が暗くなりました。今日はまだ、その感じはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 以前の暗くなる症状と現在はないことを答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My vision went dark immediately after it finished. I do not have that feeling yet today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe your previous vision-darkening symptom and say you do not have it now. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者と相談して、体勢を整えてから行います。今の体調も確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will consult the person in charge and make sure you are in a suitable position before proceeding. We will also check how you are feeling now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。針を見ると緊張するので、顔を横に向けていてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 針を見ず顔を横向きにしたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Seeing the needle makes me nervous, so may I keep my face turned to the side?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to turn your face sideways so you do not see the needle. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。始める時はこちらから声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will let you know when we are about to start.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 声をかけてもらえると助かります。終わった後も、すぐ立たずに様子を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 声かけを受け終了後すぐ立たず様子を見る希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It would help if you let me know. After it is finished, I would also like to wait and see how I feel instead of standing up immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a verbal cue and ask to wait and see how you feel after finishing instead of standing up immediately. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終了後の過ごし方も、その時の様子を見てご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also advise you what to do afterward based on how you are doing at that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。途中で気分が変わったら、すぐ言います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 途中の体調変化をすぐ知らせると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. If how I feel changes during the procedure, I will tell you immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will immediately report any change in how you feel during the procedure. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ゆっくりご案内します。どうぞお大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will guide you slowly. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の車庫の前に知らない車が止まっていて、車を出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車庫を塞ぐ見知らぬ駐車車両を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An unfamiliar car is parked in front of my garage, and I cannot get my car out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help with an unfamiliar parked vehicle blocking your garage. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車は今もそこにありますか。運転していた人は見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the car still there now? Can you see the person who was driving it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今もあります。人は見えません。十分ほど前に気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車と運転者の現在状況と発見時刻を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is still there. I cannot see anyone. I noticed it about ten minutes ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the current situation of the car and driver and when you noticed it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所と車の特徴を伺います。分かる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask you for the location and the car's features. Please tell me what you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所はこのメモです。白い軽自動車で、車庫の入口を横切る形で止まっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所車種色と入口を横切る駐車位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The address is on this note. It is a white kei car, parked across the entrance to the garage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the address, vehicle type, color, and position across the entrance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現場の状況を確認します。ご自身のお車は、まだ車庫の中ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the situation at the site. Your own car is still inside the garage, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。出ようとする前に止まっている車を見つけたので、動かしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自車は車庫内で未移動と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I found the parked car before trying to drive out, so I have not moved mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that your car is inside the garage and has not been moved. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認に伺う係から声をかけます。車庫の場所もその時に示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member coming to check will speak to you. Please point out the garage location then as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 門の内側で待ちます。入口と止まっている位置を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 門内で待ち現場確認の係に位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait inside the gate. I will explain the entrance and where the car is parked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait inside the gate and show the location to the staff member checking the site. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for contacting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日届いた箱の角が破れています。中身を確認する前に、どうすればよいか相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 届いた箱破損と未開封で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The corner of the box that arrived today is torn. I came to ask what I should do before checking the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about a damaged delivered box that has not been opened. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お届けの時の状態を伺います。受け取った時から破れていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask about its condition on delivery. Was it already torn when you received it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。配達後すぐ気づき、外から写真を撮りました。箱はまだ開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取時から破れ写真撮影済み未開封と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I noticed right after delivery and took photos of the outside. I have not opened the box yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it was torn when received, that you took photos, and that it is unopened. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配送の担当へ確認します。送り状は箱に付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the delivery staff. Is the shipping label attached to the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 付いています。番号も写っています。送り主には、まだ中身の状態を伝えられていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送り状番号と送主への中身未報告を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is. The number is also in the photos. I have not yet been able to tell the sender about the condition of the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer about the shipping-label number and that you have not yet reported the contents' condition to the sender. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中身は未確認として伺います。箱と写真を見ながら、確認方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record the contents as not yet checked. We will explain how to check them while looking at the box and photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。中身はガラスの器なので、割れていないか気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認ガラス器の破損懸念を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. The contents are glass dishes, so I am concerned about whether they are broken.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Express concern about damage to the glass dishes whose condition is not yet checked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その品物についても担当へ伝えます。まず外側の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also tell the person in charge about the item. First, we will check the outside condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この角です。今日は箱の破れと受取時の写真を示し、中身を確認する進め方を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 破れ角と受取写真を示し中身確認方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is this corner. Today I will show the tear in the box and the photos from when I received it and discuss how to proceed with checking the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the torn corner and receipt-time photos and discuss how to check the contents. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for contacting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about your bankbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この行に略した名前が載っています。どの入金か分からず、家計簿に書けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通帳略称で入金内容が分からないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is an abbreviated name on this line. I do not know which deposit it is, so I cannot enter it in my household account book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a deposit you cannot identify from an abbreviated name in your bankbook. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付と金額から確認できる情報をご案内します。こちらの行ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will explain what information can be checked from the date and amount. This is the line, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、十日の三千円です。お店の返金だと思いましたが、まだ確信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象日額と返金の推測未確定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the three thousand yen on the tenth. I thought it was a refund from a shop, but I am not sure yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the date and amount and your unconfirmed guess that it is a refund. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここには振込元の名称が表示されています。詳細を確認するため、取引の担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The name of the transfer sender is displayed here. I will connect you to the staff responsible for transactions to check the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。略されていない名称が分かれば、自分の記録と比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名称を自分の記録と照合したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. If I can find out the unabbreviated name, I can compare it with my own records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the name with your own records. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者へ、この日付と金額、表示名を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass this date, amount, and displayed name to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家計簿も持っています。自分が返金を待っている日付はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参家計簿の返金予定日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also brought my household account book. Here is the date on which I am expecting a refund.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the expected refund date in the household account book you brought. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その記録も、お客様ご自身で照合する時にお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also use that record when you make the comparison yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず担当者の説明を聞きます。入金の内容が分かってから家計簿へ記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明を聞き内容判明後に家計簿へ書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will listen to the person's explanation. I will enter it in my household account book after I know what the deposit is for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Listen to the explanation and enter it in your household account book after the details are clear. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当窓口へご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will show you to the counter in charge. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この空の容器に入れる詰め替えがほしいです。同じ商品の物はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空容器と同商品の詰替え売場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a refill for this empty container. Where are the refills for the same product?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the empty container and ask where refills of the same product are sold. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの棚です。小さい袋と二回分の袋がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: They are on this shelf. We have small pouches and pouches with enough for two refills.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 容器は四百ミリリットルです。小さい袋なら、一度で入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器四百に小袋が入るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The container holds four hundred milliliters. Would a small pouch fit in it all at once?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the small pouch fits in the four-hundred-milliliter container. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の内容量はこちらに書いてあります。容器の表示と比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The pouch's contents are listed here. Please compare that with the container's label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三百五十なので入りますね。二回分だと余りを保管するので、小さい方にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三百五十の小袋を余りを避けて選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is three hundred and fifty, so it will fit. With the two-refill pouch I would have to store the remainder, so I will choose the smaller one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the small three-hundred-and-fifty pouch to avoid leftovers. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 香りも二種類あります。容器は無香料の表示ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are also two scents. The container is labeled fragrance-free, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 無香料をお願いします。名前だけでなく、この表示も同じ物にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容器に合わせ無香料を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Fragrance-free, please. I will choose one with the same labeling as well as the same name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify fragrance-free to match the container. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらです。一袋でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here it is. Would you like one pouch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、一袋です。家の容器と容量と香りを合わせて選べました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容量香り一致の一袋購入を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, one pouch. I was able to choose one matching both the capacity and scent of the container at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the purchase of one pouch matching the capacity and scent. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27202-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
